title: Option to never show a timezone
line: The Digital Clock can now be set to never show the time zone, even when it shows a zone other than the system one.
explanation: The clock's showLocalTimezone setting was a bool: false meant "show the time zone only when the clock's zone differs from the system one" and true meant "always", so someone who picks a non-system zone in the widget (e.g. on a laptop whose system zone they can't change) always got a JST/city/offset label. The setting is now an enum (When different, Always, Never) with a third "Never" radio button on the Appearance page, and the label logic honours it. A plasma-desktop update script turns a saved true into 1 (Always), following the showSeconds bool-to-enum migration.

commits.message:
applets/digital-clock: add option to never show the time zone

The time zone could only be shown always or when the clock's time zone
differs from the system one, so it couldn't be hidden at all. Turn the
setting into an enum and add a "Never" choice next to the other two.

BUG: 469564

desktoppackage: migrate digital clock showLocalTimezone to an enum

The digital clock's showLocalTimezone setting is now an enum with a new
"Never" choice instead of a bool. Add an update script that turns a
saved true value into the matching "Always" choice so it keeps working.

BUG: 469564

patches.diff:
From 7d8f772d3cde54b9da57272c3d705918d1ab70a0 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 22:15:07 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] desktoppackage: migrate digital clock showLocalTimezone to an
 enum

The digital clock's showLocalTimezone setting is now an enum with a new
"Never" choice instead of a bool. Add an update script that turns a
saved true value into the matching "Always" choice so it keeps working.

BUG: 469564
---
 ...clock_migrate_showlocaltimezone_setting.js | 20 +++++++++++++++++++
 1 file changed, 20 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 desktoppackage/contents/updates/digitalclock_migrate_showlocaltimezone_setting.js

diff --git a/desktoppackage/contents/updates/digitalclock_migrate_showlocaltimezone_setting.js b/desktoppackage/contents/updates/digitalclock_migrate_showlocaltimezone_setting.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000..c98f864732
--- /dev/null
+++ b/desktoppackage/contents/updates/digitalclock_migrate_showlocaltimezone_setting.js
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+/*
+    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo.venerandi@kde.org>
+
+    SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+*/
+
+/**
+    @c showLocalTimezone option now also supports never showing the time zone.
+
+    @since 6.9
+*/
+
+const containments = desktops().concat(panels());
+
+containments.forEach(containment => containment.widgets("org.kde.plasma.digitalclock").forEach(widget => {
+    widget.currentConfigGroup = ["Appearance"];
+    if (widget.readConfig("showLocalTimezone", false /* Default: only when different */) === true /* Changed by the user */) {
+        widget.writeConfig("showLocalTimezone", 1 /* Always show the time zone */);
+    }
+}));
-- 
2.53.0

From c62cb9bfc7c2de69ab0688e11881b0f23b460030 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 22:15:07 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/digital-clock: add option to never show the time zone

The time zone could only be shown always or when the clock's time zone
differs from the system one, so it couldn't be hidden at all. Turn the
setting into an enum and add a "Never" choice next to the other two.

BUG: 469564
---
 applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml     |  5 +++--
 applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml | 13 +++++++++++--
 applets/digital-clock/main.xml             | 11 ++++++++---
 3 files changed, 22 insertions(+), 7 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
index 8c918109d0..f0c8adc1b3 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/DigitalClock.qml
@@ -553,8 +553,9 @@ MouseArea {
     }
 
     function setupLabels() {
-        const showTimezone = Plasmoid.configuration.showLocalTimezone
-            || (Plasmoid.configuration.lastSelectedTimezone !== "Local"
+        const showTimezone = Plasmoid.configuration.showLocalTimezone === 1 // Always
+            || (Plasmoid.configuration.showLocalTimezone === 0 // When different
+                && Plasmoid.configuration.lastSelectedTimezone !== "Local"
                 && !clock.isSystemTimeZone);
 
         let timezoneString = "";
diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml b/applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml
index bcab974d18..23d4c51697 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/configAppearance.qml
@@ -35,7 +35,7 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
     property alias cfg_fontSize: fontDialog.fontChosen.pointSize
 
     property string cfg_timeFormat: ""
-    property alias cfg_showLocalTimezone: showLocalTimeZone.checked
+    property int cfg_showLocalTimezone
     property alias cfg_displayTimezoneFormat: displayTimeZoneFormat.currentIndex
     property alias cfg_showSeconds: showSecondsComboBox.currentIndex
 
@@ -105,11 +105,20 @@ KCMUtils.SimpleKCM {
             QQC2.RadioButton {
                 id: showLocalTimeZoneWhenDifferent
                 text: i18n("Only when different from local time zone")
+                checked: appearancePage.cfg_showLocalTimezone === 0
+                onToggled: appearancePage.cfg_showLocalTimezone = 0
             }
 
             QQC2.RadioButton {
-                id: showLocalTimeZone
                 text: i18n("Always")
+                checked: appearancePage.cfg_showLocalTimezone === 1
+                onToggled: appearancePage.cfg_showLocalTimezone = 1
+            }
+
+            QQC2.RadioButton {
+                text: i18nc("@option:radio show time zone", "Never")
+                checked: appearancePage.cfg_showLocalTimezone === 2
+                onToggled: appearancePage.cfg_showLocalTimezone = 2
             }
         }
 
diff --git a/applets/digital-clock/main.xml b/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
index 6716b906c5..cc951adf77 100644
--- a/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
+++ b/applets/digital-clock/main.xml
@@ -6,9 +6,14 @@
   <kcfgfile name=""/>
 
   <group name="Appearance">
-    <entry name="showLocalTimezone" type="Bool">
-      <label>Whether the time zone should be displayed when the clock is showing the local time zone.</label>
-      <default>false</default>
+    <entry name="showLocalTimezone" type="Enum">
+      <label>When the time zone should be displayed: only when the clock is not showing the local time zone, always, or never.</label>
+      <choices>
+        <choice name="WhenDifferent" />
+        <choice name="Always" />
+        <choice name="Never" />
+      </choices>
+      <default>0</default>
     </entry>
     <entry name="showSeconds" type="Enum">
       <label>How seconds should be shown in the clock.</label>
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: clock set to Asia/Tokyo; Show time zone only offers "Only when different" and "Always", and the panel shows 06:13 (JST).
Patched: a third "Never" choice; with it applied the panel shows 06:14 with no (JST).
